numerical_characteristics.precision: 1 ULP error for 17-digit mantissas whose 16-digit prefix crosses 2^53 (9007199254740992); old code accumulated digits via FP multiply-adds (up to 17 roundings) while the fix uses uint64_t with a single conversion to double
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: mantissas around 9e16 (e.g. "90071992547409930.0"), where ULP is 16 and the 16-digit prefix exceeds 2^53
numerical_characteristics.tolerance: result must equal float(value), i.e. the correctly-rounded double; the old code returned 9.007199254740992e+16 instead of 9.007199254740994e+16 for "90071992547409930.0" (1 ULP off)
category_specific_evidence: Old code accumulated mantissa digits via number = number * 10. + digit in double, giving up to max_digits=17 rounding events before power-of-10 scaling
Fix accumulates digits into uint64_t (max ~9.9e17 < 2^64) and converts to double once, giving at most one rounding
Prefix 9007199254740993 = 2^53+1 is not representable as a double and rounded down to 9007199254740992, leaving the mantissa ~10 units below the true value
